text: For the director of music. With stringed instruments. A maskil of David. Listen to my prayer, O God, do not ignore my plea;
My thoughts trouble me and I am distraught
at the stares of the wicked; for they bring down suffering upon me and revile me in their anger.
the terrors of death assail me.
horror has overwhelmed me.
I would fly away and be at rest—
and stay in the desert; Selah
far from the tempest and storm.”
for I see violence and strife in the city.
malice and abuse are within it.
threats and lies never leave its streets.
I could endure it; if a foe were raising himself against me, I could hide from him.

as we walked with the throng at the house of God.
let them go down alive to the grave, for evil finds lodging among them.
and the Lord saves me.
I cry out in distress, and he hears my voice.
